Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Quartz Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5T and 3T
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 30 T/m (3,000 gauss/cm)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Scan Regions Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 7 mm beyond the implant.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
